attributes.background: Strengthen England’s School Food Standards so school meals help children develop healthy eating habits for life by requiring no added sugar, limiting routine cakes and sweetened desserts, increasing nutritious foods, reducing highly processed food, and strengthening monitoring and enforcement.

rejection.details:
We're not exactly sure what you mean by 'strengthen' and how you want the School Food Standards to be changed. The UK Government is introducing revised School Food Standards following a consultation. You can read the Government's plans for the new standards here: 

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6aa7af366d3764db1690455b/school-food-standards-updating-the-legislative-framework-government-consultation-response.pdf
